findings.description: Run Manifest Schema 嚴格定義了 qualification 評估所需的必填欄位 (run_id, task_id, experiment_arm, target_repo, base_commit, model_id, runtime, framework_commit, contract_id, hardware, evidence, outcome) 與 SHA-256 雜湊鏈結構。
GitWorktreeRunner 實現真實執行 git diff --binary HEAD 與 git diff --name-only HEAD，並在 Python 端自主計算 SHA-256 雜湊，搭配 ScopeGuardrail 攔截非授權目錄修改 (如 rtl/)，符合零信任證據合約。

FailureClass 結構化定義了 9 種錯誤類型 (MODEL_REASONING_FAIL, TOOL_CALL_FAIL, CONTEXT_FAIL, BUILD_FAIL, TEST_FAIL, HALLUCINATED_SUCCESS, SCOPE_VIOLATION, TIMEOUT, ENDPOINT_UNAVAILABLE)，完整涵蓋模型推理、工具調用、測試構建與治理邊界違規。
pyproject.toml 已啟用 --strict-markers 並完整註冊 unit, contract, integration, hardware, live_model, private_fixture 六大測試標籤，防止未宣告 marker 帶來的靜默偽過。

non_claims: Passing unit/contract tests alone does not prove full production deployment readiness on physical GV100 GPUs without live hardware execution.
The advisory decision does not override human reviewer sign-off for constitutional baseline modifications.
Gateway mock responses validated in contract tests do not assert actual 35B model weight convergence.
